svg.desc: Cycles: Find how much of the pattern's beginning repeats at each ending. with inputs mut position, pattern, mut matched, mut prefix and outputs finished; Extend the matched beginning or try a shorter one. with inputs byte, pattern, mut matched, mut prefix and outputs settled.
